find: for (const name of values.keys()) if (!known.has(name)) throw new Error(`unknown option --${name}`);
killedBy: parseRecordArgs (issue #815) refuses an unknown option, a missing value, a repeated option, a bad flag and a fractional frame count
why: The recorder takes exactly the options the adapter builds from a recipe. An option it silently ignored would be a way for a mistyped argument to record something other than what was asked.
